data.name: Sandeepan
data.gender_notes: Sandeepan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sandeep’, meaning ‘deep’ and ‘vast’. It is believed to symbolize the deep, endless expanse of knowledge and understanding. The name Sandeepan carries the meaning “Deep and vast” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sandeepan usually hope their child will grow to embody deep and vast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of profound wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Sandeepan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deep and vast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sandeepan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

vedic_reference.note: The name Sandeepan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sanskar', 'Dip' and 'Pan'. The meaning of Sanskar is rites, customs or rituals, Dip signifies light and Pan refers to offering. This name is believed to represent the act of lighting the path or offering guidance to someone through rituals or customs.
